concepts.title: Parity
concepts.description: Even and odd numbers, and how parity behaves under sums, differences and games.
learningObjectives: Classify numbers as even or odd using pairing and the last digit
Predict the parity of sums and differences without computing them
Use parity arguments to solve sign-placement puzzles

concepts.title: Remainders
concepts.description: Division with remainders, dot arrays, k-tables and remainder puzzle strategies.
learningObjectives: Relate dividend, divisor, quotient and remainder
Describe all numbers that leave the same remainder
Solve puzzles by reading clues as remainder conditions

concepts.title: Divisibility rules
concepts.description: Quick tests to decide whether one number divides another without long division.
learningObjectives: Test divisibility by 4, 8 and 6 using place value
Combine rules to test composite divisors

concepts.title: Shortcuts
concepts.description: Digit sums, place-value shortcuts and the alternating-sum test for 11.
learningObjectives: Explain divisibility rules using place value
Test divisibility by 9 and 3 with digit sums
Test divisibility by 11 with alternating sums

concepts.title: Digital roots
concepts.description: Repeated digit sums, the digital root cycle, and puzzles solved with digital roots.
learningObjectives: Compute digital roots by repeated digit summation
Connect digital roots with remainders modulo 9
Use digital roots to check computations and solve puzzles

concepts.title: Cryptarithms
concepts.description: Number puzzles where letters stand for digits, solved with logical reasoning.
learningObjectives: Understand the rules of cryptarithm puzzles
Solve classic two-digit and three-digit cryptarithms
